documentation:
/**
 * @function perfectSquare
 * @description the square root of a number should be an integer
 * @see [Perfect square](https://www.cuemath.com/algebra/perfect-squares/)
 * @example Perfect square - 9, 16, 25
 * @param {num} number
 */

originalTests.text:
import { perfectSquare } from '../perfect_square'

test('Check perfect square', () => {
  expect(perfectSquare(16)).toBe(true)
  expect(perfectSquare(12)).toBe(false)
  expect(perfectSquare(19)).toBe(false)
  expect(perfectSquare(25)).toBe(true)
  expect(perfectSquare(42)).toBe(false)
})

contract.method: source-reviewed curated specification; not automatic extraction
contract.description: Return whether the square root of the nonnegative input is an integer. Zero is a perfect square. Return a boolean rather than the root.
contract.domain: The input is a finite number between 0 and 1000000000.

inputRoles.num: nonnegative number whose square root is tested

contract.outputRole: whether its square root is an integer
contract.mutationPolicy: Do not modify inputs; array outputs must be fresh with independent storage.
